dct_description_sm:
This table of Income profile information for dissemination area was downloaded from the Statistics Canada website and joined with bndDisseminationArea2016 in DEM. It contains the information gathered during the 2016 Census with respect to the population within a dissemination area and the population breakdown of income and earnings by family, individuals, people in economic families, and the prevalence of low income and household income. This data covers the dissemination area in York Region only.

Statistics Canada has suppressed the profiles for certain areas due to very low population count. Suppressed areas will appear as NULL values in the attribute table.

For more information regarding this data, please refer to the reference document here: http://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2016/ref/98-501/98-501-x2016006-eng.cfm
